title: RightAlly in 20 minutes
summary: The everyday screens: your day, your leads, your deals and your money.

lessons.title: Your day starts on Today
lessons.body:
**Today** lists your calls, tasks and deadlines, most urgent first. Open it every morning.

- Press a task to do it, then mark it done.
- **Today's 10** picks ten people worth a call today, and says why.
- Red items are due today or late.

lessons.title: Leads: call within five minutes
lessons.body:
New leads land in **Leads**, from your website, Zillow, Realtor.com, Homes.com and Facebook.

Press **Call** to be connected straight away. Leads called within five minutes talk to you far more often. After the call, choose what happened, and RightAlly sets the next step.

lessons.title: Deals and documents
lessons.body:
Open a deal and press **Upload a whole file**. DocIQ reads it, scans too, files each document into the checklist, and finds the key dates.

Under each document you can **explain it in plain English or Spanish**, see **what changed** from the last version, or make a **safe link** for a lender.

lessons.title: Getting paid
lessons.body: **My money** shows each deal's commission, your split and fees, and what you will be paid. Keep your W-9 up to date there so your brokerage can send your 1099.

questions.q: Where do you see the calls and tasks for your day?
questions.why: Today lists your calls, tasks and deadlines, most urgent first.

questions.q: How fast should you call a new lead?
questions.why: Leads called within five minutes are far more likely to talk to you.

questions.q: How do you share a contract with a lender without Social Security numbers showing?
questions.why: A safe link opens a copy with sensitive numbers blacked out, and it stops working after the days you choose.
